title: Figure 34: ANSYS acoustic mesh plot, 1000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water
description: ANSYS 12.1 finite-element mesh plot (quarter-circle domain) labeled 'Uniformly Radiating Sphere, EPW=25,' captioned 'Mesh Plot for 1,000 Hz with 25 Elements per Wavelength in Water.' Dated Oct 18 2010 in the solver header. From the BAASS underwater acoustic modeling study of a radiating sphere.
